about.title: I work with you, not just for you
about.body: I'm Javier, a freelance frontend developer. I turn ideas into fast, accessible and easy-to-maintain interfaces. Every project starts with a conversation, a clear scope and a delivery plan.
about.body2: I collaborate remotely with clients on one-off jobs or in phases: discovery, interface design, implementation and final tweaks.
about.quote: Clear deliveries, deadlines met and code that stays maintainable.
